summary: A Yes vote renews the city's existing 1% transactions and use (sales) tax with no expiration date to fund city services.

tax.text: A Yes vote renews the Measure G transaction and use tax.
tax.quote: Measure G Transaction and Use Tax Renewal; November 3, 2026 General Municipal Election

tax.text: A No vote does not renew the Measure G transaction and use tax.
